text:
Anya: quick sync — thinking about the SafeStep auto-fallback UX for rollouts. idea: show the degrade mode + primary trigger on the rollout timeline (1-line reason) and let people expand to full audit. thoughts?
Kevin: agree. top-line reason is the most important for ops. we should include the trigger type (500-spike / latency / policy) and the sample request id or trace link. ensure we redact PII. :lock:
Maria: yes to the expand-to-audit. also need sampling controls — too many fallbacks = noisy audit logs. add a small sampling badge on the timeline so operators know if we sampled payloads.
Sam: UX note: hover "why" that surfaces top 3 signals (error rate, p50 latency, fallback-rate) + quick action buttons (re-run canary / rollback). keep it compact.
Kevin: operationally we want explicit TTL on audit exports. we can't retain raw request bodies >30d by default. provide an opt-in for extended retention for enterprise.
Anya: here's a proposed compact policy snippet to show inline (for devs to eyeball):
```json
{
  "policy": "safestep-v2",
  "triggers": ["error_5xx","latency_p95>1200"],
  "degrade_mode": "soft-redirect",
  "audit_sample_rate": 0.02
}
```
Maria: that's perfect. one more: show the fallback-chain — i.e., which model/region it routed to and which knob flipped (quantize / model-variant). makes postmortems easier.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout #442 to prod started by @anya — canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%.
Sam: telemetry detail request: include a compact encoded signal blob in the audit (not full payload) so analysis pipelines can consume without hitting storage explosion. maybe base64-encoded small vector of signal keys.
Kevin: add an "explainability id" to every fallback event so we can link UI -> traces -> decoder that produced the decision. helps debugging across teams.
Anya: UX trade: keep timeline uncluttered. show the 1-line reason + a small pill for mode (soft / hard / sample) and a chevron to expand audit. also add a tiny flame icon when the trigger was noisy ( > 5% traffic impacted).
Maria: also surface operator actions in the audit (who forced override, when). audit must be append-only and show the TTL and sampling policy used.
Sam: edge case: when multiple triggers fire simultaneously, show primary + "other signals" badge. don't try to compute perfect root cause in the UI.
Anya: I'll prototype a compact mock and put in Figma later today. dropping a quick sketch link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/SafeStep-rollback-mock (WIP) :eyes:
Kevin: one last thing — a CLI flag to export full audit for a given rollout id (enterprise only) with a signed job link. make sure it's gated by RBAC.
Maria: sounds good. I'll draft the audit retention doc and sample rate defaults.
Anya: cool — next step: I'll make a small PR with the timeline mock + the inline policy preview and list follow-ups. thanks! :thumbsup:
